intro.title: About the project
intro.p1: EuoraCraft Launcher (ECL) is a modern, pluggable third-party Minecraft launcher built with Python + Tauri. With just a little code you can extend the launcher through its plugin system to meet your personal needs.
intro.p2: It offers an out-of-the-box experience with multi-account login, multi-version instance management, a built-in multiplayer lobby and i18n, while a declarative permission model keeps the security boundary of plugin execution intact.

pluginConnector.desc: Extend the multiplayer lobby with custom protocols via plugins.

instanceCompat.title: Instance compatibility
instanceCompat.desc: Read read-only instance metadata from other launchers for instance compatibility.

plugin.title: Plugin system
plugin.desc: Extension points for backend plugins, themes, multiplayer connectors, auth, crash analysis and more, controlled by a declarative permission model.

palette.title: Modern UI
palette.desc: Vue 3 + Naive UI + Tailwind CSS with light/dark themes, custom appearance and a visual theme designer.

users.title: Multi-account support

instances.title: Instance management
instances.desc: Isolated multi-version instances with independent config, managing mods, resource packs, worlds, servers and screenshots together.

lobby.title: Multiplayer lobby
lobby.desc: Built-in EasyTier virtual network and room management, with plugin-based connector protocol extensions.

i18n.title: Internationalization

release.title: Version release

security.title: Secure & reliable
security.desc: Plugins run inside the host process, restricted by a declarative permission model; GPL-3.0 open source.
